test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECT?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andes mountains – Argentina and Brazil.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Andes mountains** extend from north to south through seven **South American** countries i.e Venezuela, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Bolivia, Chile, and Argentina.
 
• They are the longest continental mountain range in world.
 
• The range is **8,900 km long, 200 to 700 km wide**, and has an average height of about **4,000 m**.
 
• It is also the highest mountain range outside Asia. 
 
• The Andes are also part of the American Cordillera, a chain of mountain ranges (cordillera) it consists of an almost continuous sequence of mountain ranges that forms the western backbone of North America, Central America, South America, and Antarctica.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Sutlej River** is the **longest** of the five rivers that flow through the region of Punjab in northern India and Pakistan.
 
• The **Nile** is a major **north-flowing** river in northeastern **Africa**. It flows into the Mediterranean Sea. 
 
• **Niagara Falls** is a group of three waterfalls spanning the border between the province of Ontario in Canada and the state of New York in the United States.
